brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent cells piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full each fitted with hex-bin-full bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, capped and joint-bolted.

Configurator checks fit/mesh only. Parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material; waterproofing depends on material/process/sealing which cannot be verified. Shape provides open bins but not verified water-tightness.
Dishwasher/food/heat safety depends on chosen filament and print parameters, which the configurator does not check. Cannot claim dishwasher safe for 3D-printed parts.

finish.summary: Built compact 2-cell utensil holder with two full-depth bins. Waterproof/dishwasher-safe claims cannot be met by 3D-printed configurator alone – would require specific food-safe, heat-resistant material choice outside system scope.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
